title: Flow Part: Build Pages From Widgets | Orchard Core
description:
A landing page often mixes text, quotes, images, and other blocks, but a single body field gives editors one block of text and no way to arrange the rest.

The Orchard Core Flow part adds a list of widgets to a content item. Editors add widgets, fill them in, choose a size and an alignment for each one, and move them, all from the content editor.

In this video:
• Why the Flow part, and what a site needs to use it
• Add the Flow part to a content type, and its settings
• Build a page: add widgets, then size, align, and move them
• See the page on the site
• The Blocks editor, which picks widgets from a dialog
